title: PhotoCraft nightly deep-background icons
author: @skylartaylor

inputs.purpose: native padded Mac1024 master; not upscaled from256

method.kind: original code-generated derivative of the project-owned icon
method.transform: Fit background contribution in the existing ink/paper/background palette and change only that contribution. Preserve alpha/padding and neutral foreground/detail RGBA. Derive native-size frames separately from their corresponding unchanged-resolution masters and pack PNG frames into ICO/ICNS. No crescent, letter or badge.

validation: Source/input/output hashes, PNG CRC/dimensions and exact container members checked; supplied generator pixel proof preserves foreground/alpha. Visual comparison reviewed. Native Explorer/Finder/iconutil/app-package qualification remains unrun.
